title: Milestone 4: methodology commands, doctor checks and docs
description:
## Purpose

Make methodologies discoverable and safe to adopt.

## Scope

- `kbs methodology list` (built-in and configured, with active ones marked) and `kbs methodology show <name>` (rendered content).
- `kbs doctor` checks configured methodologies resolve and render, and warns when `CONTRIBUTING_AGENT.md` is stale against them.
- Documentation: CONFIGURATION.md entry for `methodologies`, a methodology authoring guide, getting-started notes on choosing methodologies, and a site page on kanb.us explaining that Kanbus's process opinions are pluggable.

## Definition of done

Specifications for list, show and doctor checks in both implementations; docs reviewed against real output.
